title: Publication Portfolio DNA
purpose: Keep a public-safe portfolio of publications while preserving local editorial workspace and future Docara assembly paths.
principles: The public repository is a portfolio and registry, not a raw workspace.
Full-text mirrors require an explicit per-publication policy decision.
Canonical links remain visible even when local Markdown copies exist.
Ignored `source/` stores drafts, raw copies, moderation packages and workflow evidence.
Docara output should be generated from public-safe sources, not from accidental raw workspace exposure.
Graph files describe operating contracts; raw editorial judgement remains human-owned.
